lines.line: Q1: V0 fraction over budget in [30 %, 65 %] at every level; half-width of 5-95 % range in [20,50] / [30,70] / [40,100]
Q2: yes at c = 1 and c = 2
Q3: complying margin Delta >= 0.10; its median dI at c = 2 at least 0.8 nat below the true-model V0
Q4: VF(100, 3) complies; some complying VF within 0.4 nat at c = 2; true-model cost of VF(T, 0) <= 0.15 for T >= 100
Q5: VF* above VM* by at least 0.3 nat at c = 1 and c = 2
Q6: median sd of N below 4 for T <= 100 and between 16 and 21 for V0
Q7: VF* <= 5 % over budget up to eps = 0.5; at the 2 % gross error E[N] > 2B for every variant

figure.caption: Number of transmissions above the budget (top) and information gain over constant SoD (bottom) of the one-parameter rule when the sensor's model is an estimate with covariance c J_SoD^-1 (c = 1: one constant-SoD experiment), input U, B = 316.89: median over 40 models (point) and 5-95 % range (whisker) for no correction (V0), the selected margin (VM*) and the selected count feedback (VF*). What to look at: how far each variant's whisker reaches above 0 in the top panel, and how far its points sit below the dashed true-model line in the bottom panel.
